description: pull-sync found live source under /vessels/ias-executor-ts collapsed to a fraction of its git content (content drift (live 6ddab6be15 != clone 6c70cfdf95)) while the unit was still active. A write tool truncated running vessel source; the vessel kept serving from its in-memory module, so nothing else noticed. Re-mirrored from the clone. Ops are applied against RUNTIME_ROOT (live source) rather than a scratch copy — that is the class to close.
